jobs.description:
As a Laser Operator, you will operate advanced laser cutting machines used to cut metal sheets and tubes to specification. You will monitor the quality of the production process and ensure operations run safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Setting up and operating laser cutting machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Performing quality checks on finished components.
 
• Identifying and resolving minor machine issues.
 
• Contributing to a safe and organized workplace.

 
• You have a technical education or a strong interest in technology.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

As a Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for accurately bending metal parts based on technical drawings. You ensure that every component meets the required quality standards.

Your tasks:

 
• Setting up and operating CNC press brake machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Checking the quality and dimensions of finished parts.
 
• Making minor adjustments where necessary.
 
• Maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

 
• You have a technical background or a strong technical affinity.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

Unique is looking for a Mechanic to work on trailers over 7.5 tonnes in Gullegem.
 
 
 
• Maintenance of semi-trailers, trailers and low loaders over 7.5 tonnes (NO SMALL TRAILERS) 
 
• Preparation and inspection of semi-trailers, trailers and low loaders 
 
• Diagnosis

• Aligning trailers

We are hiring! For an international global player in the logistics sector (Puurs / Antwerp region), we are currently looking for a driven 
GL Accountant. Are you ready to perform at Champions League level in a dynamic environment where ownership and change are key?
 
 

•  

Location: Puurs / Antwerp region
  

•  

Company Culture: The bar is set high, but in return, you get a huge amount of freedom and autonomy.
  

•  

Team: You will join the Regional Shared Service Center (RSSC) for Benelux, a team of 30 accountants. The RSSC serves as an internal pilot within the international group: all accounting and controlling activities are centralized and optimized here.
   

Interested? Discover the job details below:
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

End-to-End closing: Taking full responsibility for the timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings from A to Z for your assigned international entities.
  

•  

Financial integrity: Ensuring financial reliability by performing complex balance sheet analyses and in-depth reconciliations.
  

•  

Reporting: Delivering accurate internal and external financial reports on time, in compliance with both local regulations (BE GAAP) and IFRS.
  

•  

Audit & compliance: Serving as the central operational point of contact for both internal and external auditors, and proactively safeguarding internal compliance controls.
  

•  

Process optimization: Actively contributing to the continuous improvement and streamlining of accounting processes within the Regional SSC, and proactively sharing knowledge within the team.
  

•  

Business partnering: Maintaining close internal contacts with the controlling team, which provides support during the closing process and performs deep-dive analyses.
  

Qualifications
 
 

•  

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  

•  

Experience: Dynamic accountant with strong experience in General Ledger (GL) accounting, preferably gained in a complex, changing, or international corporate environment.
  

•  

Knowledge & systems:
 
 

•  

In-depth and proven knowledge of BE GAAP and IFRS.
  

•  

Excellent systems knowledge: experience with 
SAP S/4HANA and 
Excel is an absolute must. Knowledge of Power BI is a strong asset.
    

•  

Languages: Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  

•  

Essentials:
 
 

•  

Autonomous, proactive, able to structure your own work, and only satisfied when the result is delivered.
  

•  

Resilient, thriving in a dynamic, transforming environment where structures and processes evolve rapidly.
  

•  

Strong, direct, and open communicator regarding what goes well, but also brave enough to discuss mistakes to learn together.

jobs.occupation: Microsoft Dynamics Consultant - Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you looking to work on large-scale digital transformation projects with a national impact? Do you enjoy bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology while continuously developing your expertise? This opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career.

As a Business Analyst Microsoft Dynamics 365, you will support clients in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming their business processes through innovative ERP and CRM solutions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Gathering and analyzing business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Leading workshops and translating business needs into functional specifications.
• Supporting the implementation and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions.
• Acting as the liaison between business teams, consultants, and technical experts.
• Coordinating testing activities and ensuring successful user adoption.
• Contributing to complex, large-scale digital transformation programmes.

Profile

• Experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, ERP Consultant, or a similar role.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations, Business Central, Customer Engagement, or related modules).
• Strong analytical and communication skills.
• Comfortable interacting with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Intern – B2B Food Supplements
jobs.description:
Who we areFermedics is a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for food supplement brands. And we’re growing fast: in recent years we’ve roughly doubled every year. We’re riding two big waves at once, a booming supplements market and the fermentation trend. Small team, big ambitions, short communication lines. 
Your missionHelp us build a real digital marketing strategy. The basics are already there: our website, LinkedIn, Semrush for SEO/GEO analysis, newsletters and Canva. Now we need someone to bring it all together, including a content plan for our newsletter, Instagram and LinkedIn communication. 
What you’ll be doing
 
 

• SEO & GEO: dig into Semrush, spot the gaps and fix them, so both Google and LLM models like Claude & ChatGPT find us 

• Sales funnel & Campaigns: map out our funnel and set up campaigns across channels and drive conversions 

• Website: improve findability, structure and conversion 

• Content: social posts, blog posts, mailings and website copy 

• Instagram: yes, B2B. Our customers (supplement brands) are there, so we should be too. You’ll launch and grow our account 

• Influencers: get relevant influencers on board to boost our reach and visibility 

• Showcasing finished products: plan how we highlight products made with our ingredients across the website, LinkedIn and Instagram 

• Visuals: create eye-catching marketing material 
 

• A student or recent graduate in (digital) marketing, communication or a related field 

• Digital native: you know social media, content and SEO, and you’re curious about AI search 

• Strong writer in English (Dutch is a plus) 

• Creative, hands-on and independent; you like to own your projects 

• Interested in health, food (supplements) or science? Then you’ll like it here!

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service International - EN, IT, SPA, GER
jobs.description:
Are you customer-focused, organized, and eager to work in an international environment? In this temporary Customer Service role, you'll manage orders, coordinate with customers and logistics partners, and ensure an outstanding customer experience from start to finish.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a leading international organization operating within the pharmaceutical and health-related sector. Supporting customers across Western Europe, they are known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen their Customer Service team, they are looking for a temporary colleague who can help maintain their high service standards.

Omschrijving

• Manage customer orders from entry to delivery.
• Communicate with customers, warehouses, and sales teams.
• Handle returns, claims, and transport-related issues.
• Resolve customer inquiries and identify effective solutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation and ERP administration.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in customer service or administration.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics or Axapta.
• Fluent in English; Spanish, Italian of German are a strong plus.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to perform under pressure.

Our technological architecture must run alongside and support our business goals at Sopra Steria, and IT Architects make that happen by creating blueprints for software, hardware, networks, and data systems. Security and efficiency are safeguarded as IT Architects conduct risk assessments and ensure regulatory compliance. As an IT Architect, you’ll take the long view with a strategic planning mindset, deep technical knowledge, and strong problem-solving skills. Scalability as we work towards digital transformation is crucial, as we collaborate with stakeholders to adopt new technologies. 

Our Architects have the vision and leadership skills to make daring IT decisions that can make digital transformation a reality. Your ability to collaborate across teams and departments and your flexibility to adopt new technologies will help you enhance system performance, scalability, and security. Fulfil your software vision at Sopra Steria and align it with our business development goals. As a Sopra Steria Architect, you’ll have successful projects in your portfolio that can demonstrate your excellent problemsolving skills and commitment to continuous learning. 

 

Your profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! You have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Fullstack .NET development
• Git
• Docker
• Azure
• Kubernetes
• Event-driven
• N-tier
• Onion architecture
• Coaching people
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent 
• 
Languages: English and Dutch or French
